title.en: An Act Validating the Acts Performed By the Present Commercial Register of the City of Manila Since the Passage of Act Numbered Twelve Hundred and Eighty-Eight.

text.en:
All acts performed by Enrique Barrera y Caldes or by his substitute as commercial register of the
city of Manila since the date on which Act Numbered Twelve hundred and eighty-eight took effect are hereby
ratified and confirmed, and shall be valid for all purposes as though performed by a duly authorized officer.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 29, 1913.
